scenario: A municipal police department receives a public-records FOIL request for bodycam footage from a street-disturbance incident. The pipeline extracts and transcribes the incident transcript from the bodycam record, anonymizes all non-officer persons per statutory release policy (bystanders, victims, and minors must have their full names, addresses, dates of birth, and relational identifiers redacted), and assembles the final FOIL-response bundle for public distribution.
info_flow: message-parser parses the raw bodycam transcript (timestamped utterances with speaker labels) into a normalized message array → expanso-pii-redact applies statutory redaction to all non-officer persons → reporting assembles and writes the final public FOIL-response bundle to workspace/artifacts/.
